name: browser-use
headline: claude office tools: automate doc workflows
short_description: Automate office document creation and editing for PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, and PDF workflows. Ideal for operations teams to streamline document management, reduce manual effort, and integrate with existing tools.
author: tfriedel

sections.overview:
This skill packages Claude's office document manipulation capabilities for Claude Code, enabling professional document creation and editing through the command line. It supports PowerPoint presentations with HTML-to-PPTX conversion and template-based workflows, Word documents with tracked changes and OOXML manipulation, Excel financial models with formula validation, and PDF form filling and merging. Built for operations teams and developers who need to automate document generation at scale—whether generating monthly reports from databases, batch-processing templates, or triggering document pipelines from APIs and webhooks. All outputs are organized in a structured directory convention, making it ideal for integration with existing automation tools and server environments.
Generate monthly sales presentations automatically from database data
Batch convert HTML pages to formatted PowerPoint slides
Create financial models in Excel with validated formulas
Populate PDF forms programmatically from JSON data
